name: Yasaka Kanon
source:
"......Clothes, it's a hassle to put them on. Help me put them on, [url=/c104596]Yuuki[/url]."

Yuuki's twin sister and classmate.

A beautiful girl who has excellent grades and motor skills. She can do basic household chores, but often becomes listless when she does them. She is usually absent-minded and doesn't talk much, making it difficult for someone to understand what she is thinking.

She is attached and obedient to Yuuki, often following him everywhere he goes, and has no interest in anyone else other than him. When she sleeps, she likes to sleep naked.

Her magic is primarily for healing and support, but this must be kept secret since no one outside of the Yasaka family should know that they can use magic.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/nekoking/character/]Official website[/url]]

[spoiler]It is revealed later in the story that Yuuki, Kanon, and [url=/c104594]Hiiragi[/url] came from another world. Their father was a hero and their mother was a princess of a certain kingdom. When Yuuki and Kanon were infants, their kingdom was besieged by the demon lord's army, so their parents entrusted them to Hiiragi who is the hero's best friend, and sacrificed themselves in order to sent them to another world, along with the building that is now Minato Dormitory. However, their souls still reside in their children. 

In the end, they are able to go back to their world and defeat the demon lord, but leave Yuuki and Kanon behind in the current world because both of them choose to stay there, and wishing them happiness in their new lives.[/spoiler]
